description: This Java class 'LiteralUpdate' provides an update mechanism for uncompressed data within a pub/sub system, specifically handling set-based insertions and deletions with support for replacing entire datasets.

classes.name: LiteralUpdate
classes.description: A final class for representing updates to uncompressed DData, supporting insertions, deletions, and replace-all operations.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates and returns an empty LiteralUpdate with no inserts or deletes.

methods.name: replaceAll
methods.description: Creates a LiteralUpdate that replaces all existing data with the provided set of inserts.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current update, capturing the sets of inserts and deletes and the replace-all status.
